cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Verify that hash32(long) correctly delegates to the overloaded method with the default seed for the zero value.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(Long.MAX_VALUE, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Check delegation for the maximum positive long value; ensures no overflow or sign‑related bugs.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(Long.MIN_VALUE, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Check delegation for the most negative long value; verifies handling of two‑s complement edge case.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(1234567890123456789L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Typical positive long; confirms deterministic result and proper seed usage.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(-987654321098765432L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Typical negative long; ensures sign bits are incorporated correctly.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: All‑bits‑set long (equivalent to -1L); tests that the method works for a value where every bit is 1.

cases.expected: same int value as the first call with 0L (deterministic)
cases.description: Call the method twice with the same input to verify that the hash is deterministic (no random state).

group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long) - distinct inputs produce distinct hashes

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0x1111111111111111L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: First distinct long value; ensures a deterministic hash is produced.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0x2222222222222222L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED) and not equal to the hash of 0x1111111111111111L
cases.description: Second distinct long value; verifies that two different inputs do not collide (hashes differ).

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(-0x3333333333333333L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED) and not equal to the hash of the previous two values
cases.description: Third distinct (negative) long value; further confirms lack of accidental collisions.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0xFFFFFFFF00000000L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Long where only the high 32 bits are set; checks that the high half participates in the hash.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0x00000000FFFFFFFFL, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED) and not equal to the hash of 0xFFFFFFFF00000000L
cases.description: Long where only the low 32 bits are set; ensures the hash differs from the high‑bits‑only case.

group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long) - interleaved overload calls maintain determinism

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFL, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Call hash32(byte[]) before and after the long hash; the long hash must stay unchanged, proving no hidden mutable static state.

group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long) - boundary values not previously covered

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(Long.MAX_VALUE - 1L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Just below Long.MAX_VALUE; verifies correct handling of values near the upper limit.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(Long.MIN_VALUE + 1L, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Just above Long.MIN_VALUE; checks correct handling of values near the lower limit.

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(0x123456789ABCDEFL, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)

cases.expected: int value equal to MurmurHash3.hash32(-0x123456789ABCDEFL, MurmurHash3.DEFAULT_SEED)
cases.description: Arbitrary negative long with a mixed bit pattern; ensures sign extension is handled correctly.
